name: scambrake
description: Voice-first payment safety agent for social-engineering requests, built on PayPal Orders v2 Sandbox.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm --filter @scambrake/api build && pnpm --filter @scambrake/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @scambrake/api dev" "pnpm --filter @scambrake/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @scambrake/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @scambrake/web typecheck
